messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: setDummyRef possible fix
parts:
If you're experiencing the "object .setDummyRef not found" error, can you please try the following steps:
  1. Are you running Windows? If so, continue. If not, please reply to this e-mail telling us what OS you're using.
  2. Exit all existing R sessions. This is important!
  3. Start a fresh R session (I'm assuming you don't have httpuv or Shiny loaded on startup)
  4. Run these R commands:
    install.packages('httpuv', repos=c(RStudio='http://rstudio.org/_packages', CRAN='http://cran.rstudio.com'))
    devtools::install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')
  5. Try shiny::runExample('01_hello')
If that doesn't do the trick, please run sessionInfo() and reply with the results. Thanks and sorry for the inconvenience!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: setDummyRef possible fix
parts:
Sorry, scratch that, we now think we have identified the root cause. The Windows binary of httpuv that's on http://rstudio.org/_packages was built under R 3.0.1, and we're guessing everyone who has seen this problem is on R 3.0.0. I've rebuilt the httpuv binary on R 3.0.0, which should work with either R 3.0.0 or R 3.0.1.

So you should be able to fix this just by re-installing httpuv:
install.packages('httpuv', repos=c(RStudio='http://rstudio.org/_packages', CRAN='http://cran.rstudio.com'))
Please let us know if that does not fix it for you. Thanks!
